title: fix(scripts): ADR-0087 registration gate reads ui workspace packages and .tsx modules
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Ex6pB8edHJLnCCc1tgdXz5)_

Part of #26220 (parts 1 and 2 of the claim. Part 3, predicate 4 on an `any` index signature, needs ADR-0087 D8 wording and waits on the maintainer: see Acceptance notes).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- **Part 1: the package globs come from `pnpm-workspace.yaml`.** `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` drops its hand-kept `PACKAGE_ROOTS` (three roots that predate the `ui/` import). `workspaceGlobsAt(rev)` reads the workspace file at the judged rev through `workspace-enumerator.mjs`'s `parseWorkspaceGlobs` (the repo's one parse of it), and `isWorkspaceManifest` matches a listed `<dir>/package.json` against the `<dir>` / `<dir>/*` globs the way `expandWorkspaceGlob` expands them. A missing workspace file, an empty block and a glob richer than `<dir>/*` throw `WorkspaceEnumerationError` instead of reading as an empty workspace. A manifest nested below a member (a test fixture `package.json`) is no longer a member.
- **Part 2: predicate 2 now locates declarations behind `.tsx` modules.** The card listed aliases, shim re-exports and `.tsx` declarations. Measured on #26219's branch, all 16 failures had one cause: the export reader's Program had no `jsx` option, so TypeScript refused every import that resolves to a `.tsx` file (TS6142) and the aliased symbol had no declaration. The alias (`MetadataPageShell` → `PageShell.tsx`) and the shim (`useRecentItems.ts` → `RecentItemsProvider.tsx`) already resolved once the target module loaded. The fix is one option, `jsx: ts.JsxEmit.Preserve`. The Program is still `noEmit` and only syntactic diagnostics are read.
- `scripts/pm/bare-root-worklist.mjs`: its three `check-adr-0087-registration.mjs PACKAGE_ROOTS …` rows are deleted, because the bare words they judged are gone (the self-test reported them STALE: "Delete the entry"). The declaration battery's floor follows, 126 → 122 (two cases per row; 128 → 122 on a run), with a comment in the #24037 style.

## Battery rows

New battery `WS (#26220): ui workspace packages, .tsx modules, aliases and shims`, 11 cases, floor 11, roster floor 55 → 56:

- WS-G1 / G1b: a `ui/packages/*` package retires a `.tsx` export, an alias of a `.tsx` export and a type behind a `.ts` shim under `runtime-export-retired`; green, and the verdict names each declaration where the compiler resolved it (`ExpressionProvider.tsx`, `PageShell.tsx`, `RecentItemsProvider.tsx`).
- WS-R1: the same tree with the `ui/packages/*` glob removed is refused ("no workspace manifest … named `@object-ui/app-shell`"), so membership comes from the workspace file only.
- WS-R2: a rev with no `pnpm-workspace.yaml` throws, never reads as an empty workspace.
- WS-G2: `unpublished` on a private `ui/apps/*` package is green.
- WS-U1 to U5: unit pins on `isWorkspaceManifest` (`<dir>/*`, bare `<dir>`, nested manifest refused, `node_modules` and dot-dirs refused) and on `workspaceGlobsAt` refusing `packages/**`.

The self-test fixture repo now writes a `pnpm-workspace.yaml` that mirrors the real file's glob shapes (`build({ workspace })`, `null` writes none).

## Proof on the two held PRs

All with this branch's gate, `--base origin/main --head <their head>`:

- #26219 at `5bf229f6`: **exit 0**. All 54 `@object-ui/app-shell` operands verified. Before this change: exit 1 at predicate 1 on all 54; with part 1 only: exit 1 at predicate 2 on 16.
- #26293 at `e349c832`: **exit 1**, now on predicate 4 only. Predicate 1 (`@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/components` publish) passes. Predicate 4 is part 3, not done here.

## Tests and gates

- Ablation of part 2 (one-time, committed fix first, restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, blob hash re-checked): removing the `jsx` line turns `WS-G1` and `WS-G1b` red with exactly #26219's message ("the declaration of `useExpressionContext` cannot be located at the merge base"), 2 failures; restored, green.
- `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --self-test`: exit 0, "575 assertions over real temp git repos" (564 before this branch), on head `ca0155f2`.
- `node scripts/pm/bare-root-worklist.mjs --self-test`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 33 commands derived at `ca0155f2` (after merging `origin/main` `6ea429df`). All 33 exit 0, including `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main` (no declared-breaking changeset in this diff), `pnpm check:changeset-gate-self-tests`, `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` and `node scripts/pm/bare-root-worklist.mjs --self-test`. `--ran`: 33 derived, 33 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. No package is touched, so there is no build closure and no package test or typecheck to run; no test file names either edited script.

## Acceptance notes

- **Part 3 is not in this PR.** ADR-0087 D8 defines predicate 4 as "`any` / `unknown` / no annotation at base, and a concrete type at HEAD", and says to never weaken it to make something else pass. #26293's `ComponentRendererProps` is a concrete interface at base (`{ schema: TSchema; [key: string]: any; }`), and its HEAD index signature is `unknown`, which D8 also counts as erased. Admitting it changes predicate 4's definition, so it needs D8 wording first (Tier H). The proposed limb: admit an exported interface whose surface at base and HEAD is identical except that an `any` index signature carries a non-`any` value type at HEAD (`unknown` included); #6048's shape (a member removed) stays refused. The decision is with the maintainer; #26220 remains open for it.
- `scripts/check-skill-compatibility-version.mjs` carries the same three-root `PACKAGE_ROOTS`. It is outside this claim and left unchanged; whether ui packages belong to its population is that gate's question. Noted, not filed.
- No changeset: the diff touches only repository scripts, which no package publishes (`skip-changeset`).
